scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && echo "Waiting for database to start..." && sleep 5 && (test -f backend/.env || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env) && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start:all: npm run db:setup && npm run dev
